d: Anant sinh ko lekar sanjay jha ne bhi nishana sadha hai. sanjay jha ne saph kaha ki parti ke andar anushasanhinta bardasht nahin ki jaegi. sanjay jha ne kaha ki parti ispar vichar karti hai aur nikalne ka aakhiri phaisla nitish kumar ki mohar ke bad liya jata hai. aise men saval hai ki nitish kumar ne hi anant sinh ko bahar ka rasta dikhaya...
